home.title: Hi, I'm Barbara Randrianarisaona
home.subtitle: Creative FullStack Junior Developer
home.body: I blend art and code to build thoughtful, human-centered web experiences.

paragraph:
I’m from Madagascar, where I earned a degree in Chemical Engineering. I took a job in the field of EHS (Environment, Health and Safety) where I quickly grew frustrated with repetitive tasks and manual processes.

I wanted to automate, optimize, and build tools that actually make work easier. That curiosity led me to coding which I learned step by step on my own.
Then a life-changing opportunity appeared : School 42 opened in my country. I made the decision to fully commit in learning computer science and software development.

Alongside IT, I’ve always loved art : drawing, painting, sculpting, and later UI/UX design.

Frontend development felt natural to me: it’s like drawing with code. Since functionality matters as much as aesthetics, I’m also actively developing my Backend skills.

Today, I’m a Fullstack Junior Developer who enjoys creating creative, efficient solutions for people who, like I once did, are tired of repetitive work and want tools that genuinely improve their daily lives.
